name: torture-heal
description: HEAL, ROLLBACK AND CASCADE, driven deterministically. `build` writes a BAD artifact twice and a GOOD one on its third invocation; the shell gate blocks until then and heals `build`. `sibling` sits BETWEEN them precisely so it has already completed when the gate blocks — it is the cascade-invalidation probe, and it must run once per round. Expected: exit 0, build x3, sibling x3, and `build`'s re-prompts carrying the gate's findings (the agent asserts that itself and exits 9 if they are missing). Every scripted node sets retry.max 0: the harness default (2 tries, 60s backoff) is sized for transient provider 429/529s, and a scripted agent has no provider — its failures are deterministic, so retrying is pure latency. Found by a mutation test that took four minutes to fail.

spec.task:
Write the artifact.

SCENARIO: heal-after:2
ARTIFACT: torture/app.txt
EXPECT_RESPAWN: heal

A node downstream of the heal target that completes BEFORE the gate blocks, so the cascade has something to invalidate.

SCENARIO: ok
ARTIFACT: torture/sibling.txt

cmd: print('torture flow reached its final node')
